summary.headline: Leo and Virgo Sign Attributes
summary.text: Astrological descriptions of Leo and the beginning of Virgo, including their planetary houses, gender, temperament, bodily and terrestrial correspondences, stellar co-risings, and regions subject to Leo. Leo is associated with the Sun and stars or constellations including Arctophylax, Argo, the Dog, Hydra, Ophiuchus, Crater, Delphinus, Lyra, and the Eagle.
